limitations: One accepted run per configuration; small differences are preliminary.

memory_caution: Pipe-run private peak depends strongly on a large transient allocation already present before sampling. Peak/end are both reported; do not infer a 281 MiB retained leak from peak alone. Cause of the transient release not established.
average_method: Mean TD = 100*(real sample seconds / game sample seconds - 1). Memory means integrate linearly interpolated OS samples over exact sampling window and divide by real elapsed seconds, including initial transients.
